scope: Actual Intelligence/notices modules in bounded DOM/native-transport fixtures; no Android/native gameplay, visual or emulator verification

checks.name: actual model layout sends selected native topic ID with measured viewport rectangle
report image retry requests the same native topic and its report audio
missing-cache deep link refreshes completed history then selects the exact newly finished topic
report filters and empty deep links preserve native history IDs without treating starting tech as reports
cancelling a delayed native open cannot reopen the panel or send a stale selection
normal close keeps an opaque cover until native acknowledgement and paint complete
native close failure stays covered and reports failure; an explicit retry can finish
late layout response after close cannot restore the native model hole
clicking a completed-research notice opens its exact native Intelligence report
Enter and Space activate exact-ID completion notices with keyboard semantics
ordinary save/round/camera notices remove research interactivity and never open a report
duplicate engine/channel/log packets do not show twice or extend the notice lifetime
stale, foreign, malformed and pre-load packets retain original rejection rules
log fallback still skips existing history, buffers partial lines and handles truncation
battle end prevents late notices/model reopening and Duel creates neither feature
